entities.summary: Igor Ignatushkin is a Russian professional ice hockey centre who is currently playing with CSK VVS Samara of the Supreme Hockey League (VHL). Ignatushki was selected by Washington Capitals in the 8th round of the 2002 NHL Entry Draft. He played three years with HC Sochi before signing as a free agent to a one-year contract with Dynamo Moscow on July 7, 2017.
